No academy-supplied script or raw HTML executes on an academy host: the public site shares its origin with /app/ and /api/ and the CSRF cookie is script-readable. Third-party integrations are validated IDs rendered from fixed templates; user-uploaded HTML/SVG is never served inline from the academy origin.

Expenses live in new app etqan.finance. Other apps post expenses only via finance.services.post_expense(source, source_id, title, type, amount_minor, currency, spent_on, notes='') — idempotent per (source, source_id) — and withdraw_expense(source, source_id); posted expenses are read-only in the API. B4 posts paid payslips with source 'payroll.payslip', type 'salaries' (PAY-013).

Online payments live in new app etqan.gateways (Stripe + PayPal, each academy's own merchant keys, Fernet-encrypted under env ETQAN_SECRETS_KEY). Other apps take online money only via gateways.services.start_checkout(purpose, ...) with a per-purpose completion handler registered by the owning app; only the provider webhook (/api/v1/gateways/webhooks/<provider>/) marks a checkout paid. Exact signature fixed by B3b's spec.
Revenue = completed payment records only (BR-47); donations are not revenue; net profit = revenue - expenses per currency per academy month (BR-48); never summed across currencies.
Group classes are one Session row per roster student (same time, linked by the group), each with its own attendance and consumption; how a teacher is paid for a group class is B4's

Subscription keeps its meaning (one student, course, teacher, package). Multi-course, family and group subscriptions are a bundle grouping several Subscriptions; billing, payroll and notifications keep reading single subscriptions
Session.kind regular|compensation|extra|trial; only regular and compensation (not compensated) consume the package; status gains at_disposal (never consumes; today's payroll rule does not pay it)
Session.pays_teacher (default true): scheduling.payroll_sessions leaves out sessions with it off; a hand-added session in an issued month is paid as a later adjustment (P7-4)
SUB-006 payment type (prepaid/postpaid) and subscription system (normal/monthly) are B3's payment metadata, not B2's

Spanish arrives in B9d (dashboard + emails). Other phases add en and ar strings only; a missing es string falls back to English per key; the ar/en key-equality test is unchanged; the public site stays ar/en in B9.

etqan.platform.uploads (B9a) offers shared upload checks: extension + content signature table, size cap, Pillow re-encode of PNG/JPEG/WEBP, tenant_upload_path. Available for reuse; no phase is required to switch to it. Private (non-public) files use STORAGES['private'] (DJANGO_S3_PRIVATE_BUCKET in production).

Supersedes D4's interface text: other apps take online money via gateways.services.start_checkout(purpose, reference_id, provider, *, user, params=None) -> StartedCheckout{id, redirect_url, amount_minor, fee_minor, currency}, after register_purpose(name, *, prepare(reference_id, user, params) -> Prepared(amount_minor, currency, description, add_fee), complete(CompletedCheckout) -> Applied(ok, reason)) in AppConfig.ready(). A verified provider event (or, for PayPal from B3c, a verified server-side capture response) completes a checkout from any state but completed; money that cannot be applied stays as applied=false 'needs attention'. Stripe in B3b, PayPal in B3c.

Archived subscriptions and sessions (B2d) are the same rows with archived_at set, hidden only from the office's default scheduling lists and Today board. Other apps never filter on archived_at: invoices, payroll, consumption, notifications and reports keep counting archived rows (BR-46 'table + archive').
shared_decisions.source: spec 2026-10-03-b2d-archives D-2 (draft, B2d branch); P1 BR-46

shared_decisions.decision: Until B4 decides group pay, today's payroll rule pays a group class once per student row (D6), since payroll_sessions is unchanged. B2f also adds an optional member_id to etqan.platform ConflictError/ValidationError (additive; the exception handler adds it to the body when set).

Refines D5: revenue = amount_minor + fee_minor of completed billing payments, with or without an invoice, grouped by Payment.currency. Payment.invoice becomes nullable and every Payment carries its own currency (B3g).

Extends D13: PayPal completes via server-side capture POST /api/v1/gateways/checkouts/<uuid>/capture/ (re-checks still-payable under a short lock; else cancels, captures nothing); PayPal refunds/reversals only set attention. Checkouts of purposes payment_link (billing) and donation_link (finance) are readable/capturable/cancellable/simulatable by anyone holding the UUID (decided by purpose; B7 registers its own purposes for anonymous access). /app/pay/return and /app/pay/simulate/$id are public routes. gateways never imports a selling app; other apps reach gateways only through gateways.services (import contract).

Confirms D10: SUB-006 payment type/subscription system live in billing.SubscriptionTerms keyed by subscription id; B2 adds no fields or hooks; a renewal starts from defaults; office-only metadata nothing reads.

Impersonation (B9b quick login): etqan.platform.permissions.impersonator_id(request) -> int|None and the DRF permission NotImpersonating. Money-moving and messaging actions (payments, checkout, payment links, chat, broadcasts) add NotImpersonating so an admin signed in as someone else cannot pay, message or broadcast as them.

Secrets at rest: etqan.platform.secrets.encrypt/decrypt (Fernet under env ETQAN_SECRETS_KEY, D4's key) is the one helper; whichever of B3b and B9b lands first builds it in etqan.platform, the other reuses it.

Self-registration (B9c) stores scheduling preferences (start date, hours/week, preferred days, intro-call time, teacher gender) on registration.Registration; B2's trial intake may read them through registration.services.preferences(registration_id). B9c books nothing itself.

Spanish (B9d): dashboard es files are a subset of en (plural-stripped keys, same placeholders), tested separately from the unchanged ar/en equality test; identity emails fall back to English when an es template is missing; other apps' language rules unchanged (notifications give an es reader the academy default). Later areas need no es file.

Every new or renewed subscription takes its default price and currency from catalogue.services.package_price(package, country=student.country): the country row while country_pricing is on and a row exists, else the package's own. Create/renew take an optional currency; an explicit price_minor is in the resolved currency and a different currency is 400 catalogue.price_currency_changed. P4-10 compares with the resolved currency. Group bundles: explicit price only when all members resolve to one currency; roster add copies the template price only on a currency match. Existing subscriptions keep their snapshot.

Cross-currency figures only via finance.services.convert_estimate(lines) -> Estimate(currency, amount_minor|None, missing, as_of): manual current rates to the academy currency, exact sum rounded once, null (never partial) when a rate is missing, always labelled an estimate next to the per-currency figures (extends B3-4).
etqan.platform.exceptions.ValidationError gains an optional code (default validation_error), additive like D15's member_id; the exception handler adds it to the body.

Learning data for B10: learning.services.progress_of(student_user_id, *, month) -> list[CourseProgress] (per course: level at the month's end, topics completed in the month, completed_total/total_topics, level changes and upgrade decisions in the month; month = calendar month in the academy's timezone). A student's level is kept per (student, course), not per subscription, so renewals/bundles/group rows keep progress; B6 needs nothing from B2f. B6 sends no notifications: B5 finders call B6's read services (each B6 slice names its own).

dashboard nav gains optional NavItem.badge (count badge, 99+ cap, 60s refresh) with NAV_BADGE_LABELS in nav.ts and a badges prop on AppSidebar/AppShell — additive shell change outside the phase markers, first used by B9c Registrations — no nav badge existed; reuse it rather than copying — cost if wrong: a small merge in AppShell/AppSidebar

Refines D13/D17: a purpose is anonymous-capable via register_purpose(name, prepare=, complete=, public=False); gateways.services.is_public_purpose(name) gates anonymous read/capture/cancel/simulate by checkout UUID. Prepared gains use_switch (default True): fee_for(..., use_switch=) — with use_switch=False the purpose's own add_fee decides at the current fee_basis_points regardless of the academy fee switch. still_payable re-runs prepare with params=RECHECK ({'recheck': True}); public routes must build params only from server-side values (never forward request data).

Extends D26 (B6b): learning.services.homework_events(*, since, until) -> list[HomeworkEvent(kind 'set'|'answered'|'completed', homework_id, student_user_id, course_id, set_by_user_id|None, at)], window [since, until) aware UTC, inside tenant_context, derived from current state (not an event log); B5 resolves parents via identity.services. learning.services.homework_of(student_user_id, *, month) -> list[HomeworkMonth(homework_id, course_id, course_name_en, course_name_ar, title, status, set_on, answered_at, completed_at)] for homework set or completed in the academy-timezone month.

Refines D17: the public return page (/app/pay/return) calls /identity/me/ only for checkouts whose purpose is not public (e.g. invoice) — anonymous link payers never hit authed endpoints; for those checkouts it renders back/retry links only after me has settled. B7's public purposes get the anonymous behaviour automatically.

Refines D24: exchange rates live in etqan.finance — one hand-entered current rate per currency against the academy default_currency, Decimal(20,10), exchanged as a fixed-point string. finance.services.convert_estimate(lines) -> Estimate(currency, amount_minor|None, missing, as_of) is the only cross-currency path; it returns None while the exchange_rates feature is off (requires=(), default off); computes exactly in decimal.localcontext(prec=60, Inexact trapped) as sum(amount_minor × rate / 10^d(cur)) × 10^d(base), quantized once ROUND_HALF_UP (away from zero); zero-amount lines skipped; any non-zero line without a usable rate → amount null and its code in missing (never partial); as_of = oldest rate used; current rates, always labelled an estimate.

Extends D26/D29 (B6c): learning.services.review_summary(*, teacher_user_id=None, student_user_id=None, since: date, until: date) -> ReviewSummary(count: int, average: float|None) over eligible reviewed sessions with since <= occurs_on < until (average rounded to 2 places, None when count 0); learning.services.reviews_of(student_user_id, *, month: date) -> list[ReviewMonth(session_id, occurs_on, course_id, course_name_en, course_name_ar, teacher_user_id, teacher_name, rating, comment)] for that calendar month, oldest first. Eligible = completed, student present, has a subscription, kind != trial. Reviews change nothing else (no pay effect).

Extends D26/D29/D32 (B6d): learning.services.certificates_of(student_user_id, *, month: date) -> list[CertificateMonth(certificate_id, course_id, course_name_en, course_name_ar, kind, issued_on, revoked)] for certificates issued in that calendar month. No B5 hook (COMM-004 has no certificate notice). Recorded-course certificates are B7's: any change to learning.Certificate/issue_certificate is a request to B6. Public verification: anonymous GET /api/v1/learning/certificates/verify/<code>/ (unguessable code, per-IP throttle, verified_certificates requires certificates).

Bundle-row API errors are keyed in dot form rows.<i>.<field> (e.g. rows.0.price_minor), matching DRF and the dashboard server-error mapping (react-hook-form cannot use rows[i]). B3d D-5 and R2 item 4 read rows[0].price_minor as rows.0.price_minor. Whichever of B3d and B2f builds D-5 first keys it this way.

After B3d, create/renew subscription calls that send price_minor without currency read it in the student's resolved currency (no error), so any form or caller that sends price_minor MUST also send currency. B3d forms do; B2f group/bundle forms and any later caller must too. Row errors use dot keys (D34).

Refines D16 for the wallet (B3e): wallet top-ups are revenue when they arrive; payments with method wallet are never revenue (the money was already counted at top-up, so counting it again would double it); a payment moved into the wallet (status credited) stays revenue. Still per currency, never summed across currencies (D5).
Wallet balances are read only through wallet.services.balances_of(student_user_id), which returns per-currency balances; later phases (B4, B7, B11) never query wallet models directly.

Billing guards (delete_payment, refund_payment, update_record) decide on the payment row re-read under select_for_update, and refuse wallet-method, wallet_topup and credited payments with distinct billing.* codes; only etqan.wallet may move or undo wallet money (record_wallet_payment, credit_payment, record_topup_payment, refund_topup_payment are etqan.wallet-only).

Notifications stay pull-based (N8-2): no app imports etqan.notifications; every B5 notice (incl. chat) is a finder over the owning app's read service. B5d will ask B2 (postponement, substitute, schedule-change events) and B6 (level-upgrade decisions) for windowed read services shaped like D29's homework_events(*, since, until), as requests. COMM-007's nine per-session reminder stamps are not built as Session fields: per-type offsets + the Notification row (dedupe_key, created_at) cover them, so B2 adds no notification fields. Per-person comms settings (teacher WhatsApp group, student chat switches, notice preferences) live in B5-owned tables keyed by user id, not on identity profiles.
WhatsApp provider is the official WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta); no group posting; stub until credentials

HOLD B5c (WhatsApp sending) until the owner's integrations design is approved: hybrid model — Etqan provides a default account per service, an academy may switch to its own in Settings → Integrations. Build other B5 slices first; design B5c's provider behind that model.

Outside services go through etqan.integrations.resolve(service) (Etqan default or the academy's own account); no phase stores keys of its own; usage on Etqan defaults is recorded via etqan_billing.record_usage. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-integrations-and-etqan-billing-design.md (branch feat/integrations).

Refines D36 and D38: billing payments with method code (B3f system codes) are never revenue; a code is revenue only when the academy records its sale as a payment record. Billing refuses to refund or delete (refuse_reserved_money, alias refuse_wallet_money) or move to the balance (credit_payment's own check) a code payment (409 billing.code_payment). Only etqan.vouchers records one (settle_with_code, record_code_payment) or removes one (delete_code_payment, discounts only, office with voucher.update + payment.update). Activation and renewal redemptions are final.
Later phases (B7 recorded courses, P1 RC-003 activation code) reach system codes only through vouchers.services; B7 asks B3 for a new kind rather than reading voucher models.

B4, B7 and B10 are launched SPEC-ONLY with no slot (owner, 2026-10-08): worktrees exist, status stays waiting-deps, they write specs and slice plans only, no stack. Conductor: when a slot frees and a phase's deps allow building, give these phases a slot (phase <CODE> --slot n, stream-env.sh, just dev-backend) before launching anything new.
Catalogue's _delete message reads 'is used by subscriptions or system codes' (B3f F-25); the code catalogue.in_use is unchanged. VoucherBatch course/package/teacher FKs are PROTECT.

Group-class pay (settles D6/D15): payroll setting group_pay per_student (default, today's behaviour) | per_class. A class = paying rows sharing teacher, subscription.bundle_id of a kind=group bundle, starts_at and minutes (B2f F-4); sessions without a subscription are never grouped. per_class: lowest-id row is the carrier (paid at its own rate, highest weight of the class), others are member lines at 0, all locked at issue; late rows of a paid class are not reported as unpaid. Payroll reaches bundle via field paths on payroll_sessions; no B2 change.

P7-2 becomes configurable behind payroll_rules (off by default): per-academy weights (basis points) for student-absent and student-excused sessions and an opt-in to pay at_disposal sessions; defaults reproduce P7-2 exactly; the teacher-attendance gate is never configurable. Session amount = round_half_up(rate*minutes*pay_bp, 600000).

AI lives in new tenant app etqan.ai and calls Claude only through integrations.resolve('ai'); B10a replaces integrations' NotYet AI provider (providers/ai.py + dashboard AiAccountForm, under a claim on etqan.integrations; probe = models.retrieve, a deviation from integrations §3.3's one-token call). Generation is a draft (AiDraft, Celery, polled), never a write: other phases that want an AI action (B7 playlist content, later course SEO fields) ask B10 by request for an entry in etqan/ai/registry.py and mount the dashboard AiDraftButton; no other app imports anthropic. Metering via ai.services.meter -> etqan_billing.record_usage once integrations slice 2 lands. B10a cannot build until integrations slice 1 is merged (not a ledger slice).

B7 sales are revenue: each B7 purpose's complete() records the money via billing.services.record_link_payment(...) (standalone record, notes name the sale) inside one atomic block with its own row, and hand-paid B7 sales via billing.services.create_record(...). A checkout's reference_id is always a B7-owned pending row (recorded.Purchase; the consultation booking). An unappliable sale records nothing and returns Applied(ok=False) (needs attention). B7 asks no billing change.

Consultations (etqan.consultations) are not scheduling Sessions: own time, link, statuses, attendance. Slots come from scheduling.services.windows_of minus the teacher's non-cancelled sessions (sessions_queryset) and other consultations; self-booking needs teacher_availability on. Scheduling's conflict warnings do not see consultations; B2 needs no change.

requests.what: Optional, non-blocking (B3g): one line in dashboard/src/routes/_authed/scheduling.subscriptions.$subscriptionId.tsx rendering SubscriptionTermsCard exported from features/billing, once B3g merges.

B3d country-pricing hook (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-05-b3d-countries-currencies-design.md §4.2, §7, D-4..D-6; ledger D23). Additive, no model/migration. BACKEND etqan/scheduling/services/subscriptions.py: (1) create_subscription(..., currency=None): after _copy_package resolve price = catalogue.services.package_price(package, country=student.country); currency given and != price.currency -> ValidationError(field='price_minor', code='catalogue.price_currency_changed') (D25); subscription.currency = price.currency; price_minor = price.price_minor if price_minor is None else price_minor. (2) renew_subscription(..., currency=None): resolve for the old subscription's student + new package, same check; P4-10 -> old.price_minor if price.currency == old.currency else price.price_minor. (3) SubscriptionCreateInput/RenewInput gain optional currency (3 letters, upper-cased); bundle rows inherit it. (4) B2f group bundles: explicit price_minor refused 400 rows[0].price_minor unless all active members resolve to one currency; without price each member takes its resolved default; add_to_group_bundle copies template price only on a currency match. DASHBOARD: TermFields optional studentId -> prefill/currency from usePackagePrice(packageId, studentId) (@/features/catalogue), reset price when resolved currency changes, submit disabled while pending; SubscriptionForm passes watch('student') and sends currency; RenewDialog passes the student, prefills by P4-10 vs the resolved currency, sends currency; B2e conversion + B2f family/individual forms pass studentId; group form shows no price prefill and sends no price when members' currencies differ. TESTS: listed in the spec §7. EXECUTION: B2 makes it, or delegates to B3 under a claim; it needs B3d's package_price/usePackagePrice, so commits go on B3d's branches and backend+dashboard land in B3d's merge pair; rebase on whichever of B2e/B2f merges first. B3d is not queued until it is in.

B3e wallet compensation hook (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-06-b3e-student-wallet-design.md E-23, §4.2, §7). Additive only: no model, no migration, no change to any existing signature. BACKEND etqan/scheduling/services (exported from the package): claim_session_for_balance(session_id: int) -> Session, @transaction.atomic, locking as create_compensation does (read the session's subscription_id unlocked, select_for_update the subscription, then select_for_update the session, re-checking the subscription id). Refusals: a missing session or one without a subscription -> ValidationError(field="session"); an archived subscription -> the existing refuse_if_archived (as B2d D-7 does for make-ups); session.compensated -> ConflictError(code="scheduling.already_compensated"); session.kind == "compensation" -> ConflictError(code="scheduling.not_compensable") (the lesson is owed through the original); not is_compensable(session) -> ConflictError(code="scheduling.not_compensable"). Otherwise set compensated=True (update_fields compensated, updated_at) and return the session. The wallet reads values through the existing sessions_queryset and is_compensable; nothing else is added. DASHBOARD: routes/_authed/scheduling.sessions.$sessionId.tsx renders <SessionWalletCard sessionId={sessionId} /> from @/features/wallet under SessionPage (one import, one line; the card hides itself without wallet.create or balances). STRINGS: "made up or compensated" replaces "has a make-up session" in en and ar for sessionClasses.frozen and errors.scheduling.has_compensation / already_compensated, and in the backend messages of refuse_if_compensated (services/attendance.py:66-68) and create_compensation's already-compensated refusal (services/manual.py:240-244); codes unchanged. TESTS: a claim marks compensated; a second claim is 409 already_compensated; a scheduled, an extra and a compensation-kind session are 409 not_compensable; an archived subscription is refused; after a claim create_compensation is 409 already_compensated and attendance/restore are refused; the claim's FOR UPDATE order is subscription then session (captured SQL); every existing scheduling test passes unchanged. EXECUTION: B2 makes it or delegates to B3 under a claim (as R2); commits go on B3e's branches and land in B3e's merge pair. If it is not in when B3e's Part A has passed review, B3e merges without it and wallet compensation moves to B3f. NOTE (not part of this request): a cancelled make-up releases its original and is itself compensable, so an original and its make-up can both be made up today; B2 may want to look at that.

B3e follow-up (final review I-1): a session claimed for balance (claim_session_for_balance sets compensated=True) still counts as owed in sessions_remaining, because nothing consumes it, so the student gets the money and keeps the lesson. A make-up consumes when delivered; a balance credit never does. Ask: should a balance-compensated session count as consumed? R3 had to be additive and could not tell the two apart (both set compensated). Options: a field such as compensated_by='balance' (migration) so rules.consuming counts it, or accept and document. B2 decides; if code is needed, B2 builds it or delegates to B3 under a claim. Not blocking B3e's merge (feature off by default); B3e's PR notes it.

R-B5b-1 (B5b broadcasts, spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-b5b-broadcasts-design.md §7): once B2f merges, an additive read-only service exported from etqan.scheduling.services: study_group_members(group_id: int) -> StudyGroupMembers(name: str, is_active: bool, student_user_ids: list[int]) — all members of the B2f study group (no eligibility filtering; notifications does that); NotFoundError for a missing group; fixed query count. Non-blocking: B5b ships without the study-group audience if it is not in, and the audience moves to B5d.

R-B5d-1 (B5d more notices, spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-b5d-more-notices-design.md §4 R6): additive read-only services exported from etqan.scheduling.services, each a fixed query count, returning Session objects with student__user, teacher__user, course selected: (a) teacher_absences_marked(*, since) — non-cancelled sessions with teacher_attendance='absent' and marked_at>=since; (b) sessions_ended(*, now, after, give_up) — status scheduled, both attendances not_set, ENDS_AT in (now-give_up, now-after]; (c) postponements(*, since, until) -> list[Postponement(entry_id, session, previous_starts_at, new_starts_at, by_user_id, at)] from B2c POSTPONE activity entries (moves back included); (d) sessions_booked(*, kind, since, now) — sessions of kind created >= since, starts_at > now, not cancelled; (e) after B2g: substitutions(*, since, until) -> list[Substitution(id, subscription_id, student, course, regular_teacher_user, substitute_user, starts_on, ends_on, created_at)]. Non-blocking: each B5d notice is built only when its service exists.

R-B5d-2 (B5d more notices, spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-b5d-more-notices-design.md §4 R7): additive, UNSCOPED (no user) read-only services exported from etqan.learning.services, fixed query count: (a) homework_notices(*, since, until) -> list[HomeworkNotice(kind 'set'|'answered'|'completed', homework_id, title, course_name_ar, course_name_en, student: StudentProfile with user selected, set_by_user_id, set_by_role, at)] (derived from homework_events); (b) upgrade_notices(*, since, until) -> list[UpgradeNotice(kind 'requested'|'decided', request_id, student: StudentProfile with user, course_name_ar, course_name_en, level_name_ar, level_name_en, status, requested_by_user_id, requested_by_role, at)]. Non-blocking: each B5d notice is built only when its service exists.

escalations.question: B9c (password reset by one-time code) needs an SMS provider account (e.g. Twilio, Vonage, Unifonic for Gulf/Egypt numbers) to send codes to phones in production. Which provider, and will you supply the account/keys? Until then B9c ships with console/test SMS backends and hides the phone option in production; email codes work.
escalations.answer: Owner (2026-10-03): Twilio. Build a Twilio SMS backend behind the existing provider interface, keys read from env (e.g. TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_FROM), tested with mocks only; console/test backends stay for dev/CI. The phone option stays hidden in production until the keys are set; the owner supplies the account at deploy time.

escalations.question: WhatsApp provider for B5c (spec 2026-10-07-b5-communication §3, B5-5): which WhatsApp sending service/account should academies use (e.g. WhatsApp Cloud API / Twilio / a linked-number gateway like TutorHamster's, which also posts to group IDs)? Not blocking: B5c ships a provider interface with an outbox stub that sends nothing; a real provider is a later one-file change once you choose and supply test credentials.
escalations.answer: Owner (2026-10-07): use the official WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta). Build the B5c provider against the Cloud API; keep the stub as the default until the owner supplies test credentials (phone number id + access token). Note: the Cloud API does not post to WhatsApp groups — group messaging is out unless a later decision adds a gateway.
